interventions.description: Replace the continuous open frontage with clearly defined, narrow driveway curb cuts to limit the points where vehicles cross the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Enforce Clear Walkway Zones
interventions.description: Implement and enforce regulations to prevent the storage of tires and equipment in the public right-of-way.
